title: helianthemum glaucum var. stoechadifolium
intro: Helianthemum glaucum var. stoechadifolium, commonly known as Rockrose, is a type of flowering plant in the family Cistaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its potential to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system and promote a sense of calmness, which may be beneficial in treating anxiety disorders. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, such as dihydrokaempferol and dihydroquercetin, as well as iridoids and diterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
